guides.treatment_action:
Recommended treatment actions:  
- Implement and enforce multi-factor authentication for all remote access to SRV-03 and SRV-04  
- Apply the latest security patches to address CVE-2017-0144 and CVE-2021-31166 on affected hosts  
- Configure firewall rules to restrict remote access to SRV-03 and SRV-04 to only necessary ports and IP ranges  
- Conduct regular vulnerability scans and network security assessments to detect and mitigate exposure risks

guides.evidence_description: The implementation of firewall rules restricting remote access to SRV-03 to necessary ports and IP ranges provides evidence that host SRV-03 complies with control 6.7 by mitigating network-based exploitation risks through secure remote working configurations.

implementation_steps.expected_result: The treatment action is applied on SRV-03 and the technical state reflects the intended hardening or remediation for SMB Remote Code Execution.

implementation_steps.title: Verify Control Effectiveness
implementation_steps.description: Run post-change validation on SRV-03 to confirm the implemented control reduces exposure to SMB Remote Code Execution (CVE-2017-0144) and that the host remains operational.
implementation_steps.expected_result: Post-change validation shows the host is operational and the applied control provides measurable reduction of exposure for SMB Remote Code Execution.
implementation_steps.output_type: Validation output / firewall rule list / event log excerpt
implementation_steps.evidence_capture: Capture post-change validation output, firewall or policy results, and relevant logs for SRV-03.
